note: WHY THESE ARE A NAMED SET AND NOT A DERIVED ONE. D301 adds ONE rung, `W`: the kind-1 hoist asked as SAME VALS WRAPPER (`repStructSlotsTwin` over the two ref-list rows' element struct rows) rather than as ref-list slot EQUALITY. Every derived population prices it at ZERO — 0 of 1,477 behavioural classes and 0 of 250,767 census cells move in either direction, and all 1,913 buildable corpus modules are `cmp` byte-IDENTICAL across it — while the counters say it is live: 6,562 reaches in 23 files, 950 ANSWERS in 5. What it closes is a population the census does not contain: its `twin` axis crosses declaration twins and its `cont` axis picks ONE container per cell, so no coordinate carries a SECOND declared layout twin beside a nested container. The two programs below carry that price into the 7-second gate.

refused.buys: IT DOES CLOSE D301 — which corrects the filed row. Built as master + the wide hoist (1,464,911 bytes) and run on D301's filed repro verbatim: RUNS, prints `0 0`. The row's `still check-clean invalid wasm` was wrong. It buys nothing OVER the shipped narrow rung, though: same closure, same witnesses, and it additionally moves 4 classes check-clean invalid wasm -> loud emit reject.
refused.candidate: the kind-1 hoist asked through the WHOLE `rlSlotsLayoutTwin` — D300's own refused wide candidate, re-measured here because D301's row filed it as not closing this defect
refused.mechanism: `rlSlotsLayoutTwin`'s CROSS-TABLE arm merges a registered ARM slot with a plain-struct slot, and `mvCanonRepOf` is also the chokepoint for `mvValStructIdxOf` / `mvValVariantOf` — so the store-side seed switches from `svCtx.structIdx` to `svCtx.variantIdx` and the bare `null` in `{ r: null }` loses its struct-typed context. The shipped `W` asks only the STRUCT-ROW leg of that relation, which is the wrapper question and nothing else, so the cross-table arm never fires.
refused.price: 4 behavioural classes / 21 census cells `runs` -> `loud emit reject` (b021395 [4], b021396 [3], b021398 [9], b021399 [5]), all `emitProgram: bare null needs a struct-typed context` — cell-identical to the price D300 measured for the same candidate (scripts/silent-sweep/census/d300-rung-price.json). The shipped narrow rung costs ZERO. The four classes are already BLOCKING in distilled/cells/, so this price needs no extra named cell; it is recorded here so the next reader does not pay it again.
